title: RLSplat: Resource-Linear Budget Control for Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: arXiv:2610.27712v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (FF3DGS) reconstructs 3D scenes from images in a single forward pass, making it well-suited to applications that must operate within limited resource budgets. To further improve its practicality, recent budget-controllable FF3DGS methods allow the number of Gaussians to be adjusted at inference, so that the output meets a given storage limit or rendering-latency constraint. However, these methods overlook the cost of inference itself: to produce a representation with the target number of Gaussians, they first predict a dense set of Gaussians and then prune or select from it, requiring nearly constant latency and peak memory regardless of the budget. We therefore propose RLSplat, a resource-linear budget-controllable FF3DGS framework whose representation size, inference latency, and peak memory all decrease linearly as the Gaussian budget is reduced. translated_title: RLSplat：面向前馈式3D高斯泼溅的资源线性预算控制
translated_abstract: 前馈式3D高斯泼溅（FF3DGS）通过单次前向传播即可从图像重建3D场景，因此非常适合必须在有限资源预算下运行的应用。为了进一步提升其实用性，近期的预算可控FF3DGS方法允许在推理阶段调整高斯的数量，使输出满足给定的存储上限或渲染延迟约束。然而，这些方法忽略了推理过程本身的成本：为了生成具有目标高斯数量的表示，它们需要先预测一组稠密的高斯，再从中进行剪枝或选择，导致无论预算大小如何，推理延迟和峰值内存都几乎保持恒定。为此，我们提出了RLSplat，一个资源线性的预算可控FF3DGS框架，其表示大小、推理延迟和峰值内存均随高斯预算的减少而线性下降。不同于剪枝或选择的方式，RLSplat学习一种高斯……
tldr: RLSplat提出了一种资源线性的预算可控前馈式3D高斯泼溅框架，摒弃了先预测稠密高斯再剪枝或选择的做法，使表示大小、推理延迟和峰值内存随高斯预算的减少而线性下降。
en_tdlr: RLSplat introduces a resource-linear budget-controllable feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that avoids pruning or selection, enabling representation size, inference latency, and peak memory to all decrease linearly as the Gaussian budget shrinks.
